Spot between the purple chair and red bed, against the wall. the bed is on.

yes it is.

what can you see?

where in the room?

a larger stove and a mirrored back splash.

a long island that has a blue counter top.

im in the living room in front of the couchs.

middle onw.

im on the first floor in front of the stairs.

im in the dining room table with a white cloth on it.

near the middle of it and yes.

it at them now.

im in the garage. its a empty room.

purple rug. Two brown chairs are across from a couch and there is another couch here next to it. There is some white in carpet too.

middle of purple carpet.

In middle of the red rug.

tiny bathroom gray floor. There is a small white mat in front of sink.

at white carpet.

can you tell me about the room?

rocking chairs. on a wood floor.

just outside the roof.

is the bathroom off of a bedroom?
